pictures.scene: El Greco, Christ in the Garden of Olives — Christ kneeling alone in the dark with the angel above Him, a prayer of one who is afflicted when he grows faint and pours out his lament before the LORD, hear my prayer O LORD
pictures.name: pd_greco_gebed

pictures.scene: Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, Christ Healing the Paralytic at the Pool of Bethesda — the paralytic on the ground reaching up toward Christ, let my cry for help come before You, do not hide Your face from me
pictures.name: pd_murillo_roep

pictures.scene: Ivan Aivazovsky, The Ninth Wave — survivors clinging to a broken mast under an enormous sea at sunrise, in my day of distress, incline Your ear to me, answer me quickly when I call
pictures.name: pd_aivazovsky_nood

lines.text: A prayer of one who is afflicted, when he grows faint and pours out his lament before the LORD.
let my cry for help come before You.
Do not hide Your face from me
answer me quickly when I call.
